details.description: StarCoder is a 15.5-billion-parameter code-generation model from the BigCode project, trained on over 80 programming languages from The Stack (v1.2), with opt-out requests excluded, using multi-query attention and a fill-in-the-middle training objective over roughly 1 trillion tokens. It is a base code-completion model rather than an instruction-tuned assistant, and the model card says it works best with a 'Tech Assistant' style prompt instead of direct commands. BigCode's current model listing presents the newer StarCoder2 family as its successor generation.
advantages: Scores 33.6% pass@1 on HumanEval, rising to 40.8% pass@1 with a prompted 'Tech Assistant' format, per the model card.
Scores 52.7% pass@1 on MBPP, per the model card.
Trained on 80+ programming languages with an 8,192-token context window, per the model card.
disadvantages: Superseded by the StarCoder2 family, which BigCode's model listing presents as its current generation of code models.
Not an instruction-following model; the model card says it performs better with a specialized 'Tech Assistant' prompt than with direct natural-language commands.
The model card warns generated code 'is not guaranteed to work as intended' and can be inefficient, contain bugs, or reproduce training data verbatim.
use_cases: Code completion and generation across 80+ programming languages
Technical-assistant style code Q&A when used with the Tech Assistant prompt format

notes: The catalog rounds StarCoder's 15.5B parameters to the slug 'starcoder-16b'; this is BigCode's original StarCoder (bigcode/starcoder on Hugging Face), not StarCoder2.
